svg.text: home — the dependencies of every file
An arrow A → B: A needs B. Each page wires its own files (the host); the rooms and the house know each other only through the interfaces room.js and shell.js; core and library know no project.
root — the menu and the interfaces
core/ — shared code, knows no project
uses (a script tag and its code)
External (CDN, no lines): SheetJS (xlsx), Google Fonts, three.js r128, OrbitControls, Alpine.js. Not drawn: *.md (docs), archon/ (the drawings building.dat.js comes from). 102 dependencies.
